results.title: Please Hold
results.overview: Laurent and Sophie called on Gagu, the home furniture assembly specialist, to assemble the crib for little Lea, who is due in a few weeks, in just one hour. But Laurent and Sophie didn't opt for the automatic delivery option, and their "GaguMan" ends up spending more than an hour at their home...

results.title: First Five
results.overview: An unprecedented, intimate look at the five young men who served as Coach Bob Knight's very first recruiting class for the Indiana University basketball team from 1971 to 1975.

results.title: Sunlight Water
results.overview: When a lonely, recently single woman rescues a houseplant in need of serious TLC – and then falls in love with it – she must discover what the plant really wants, or risk losing herself forever.

results.title: Gamberra
results.overview: During her first year at a conservative, elitist college residence, Marta is driven into a desperate search for the morning-after pill by the sexual taboos around her. As community pressure builds, her peers prepare an initiation ritual no one will forget.

results.title: Once Upon a Time in Seattle
results.original_title: Once Upon a Time in Seattle
results.overview: Comprised of moments from over 40 films shot in Seattle, and a few irresistible facsimiles, Once Upon a Time in Seattle is part love letter, part loony action adventure, and part free-associative meditation on the transience of landscape in a city that has always had a complicated relationship with honoring its past while moving swiftly into the future.

results.title: Back to Tottori
results.overview: The film follows Billie and Vega, six years after the events of the first film. The family is falling apart. Their father is gone, their mother is exhausted and unavailable, and Vega has lost her footing. Billie longs for the strength she and her sister once found together, what they called their superpower. When Vega herself makes the choice to be hospitalized, Billie decides to take action. With her father's analog camera as her companion, she embarks on a journey that is both physical and emotional. Along the way, she encounters people and situations that challenge her, but also give her strength. She must trust herself, improvise, and deal with the unexpected.

results.title: Every Dog Has Its Day
results.overview: Old Lin, a retired steel mill veteran with mobility issues, lives a materially comfortable yet emotionally desolate life. His routine is unexpectedly disrupted when he crosses paths with Ma Teng, an idle drifter brimming with "useless knowledge" and a chronic habit of abandoning projects midway, during a botched caregiver interview. What begins as a comedic clash of misunderstandings evolves into an extraordinary companionship. Through their unlikely journey bridging generational and social divides, the mismatched pair transforms from chaotic strangers into mutual pillars of support. This transgenerational bond defying conventional boundaries of age and mortality becomes a profound testament to human resilience. In each other's flawed existence, they discover the courage to confront physical decline and mortality, ultimately unearthing the fortitude to embrace life's uncertainties with renewed bravery.

results.title: Я тебя не вижу
results.overview: A teenager's attempt to hold on to his mother ends in tragedy—now their relationship feels more like a death sentence than love. This is a story about blindness that begins long before darkness, and about trying to find a way to "move on," even when it seems there's no "move on."

results.title: The Man in the Second Story Window
results.original_title: The Man in the Second Story Window
results.overview: A Man sits at a desk, typing. Another Man sits across from him in a chair, sleeping. Outside, beneath them, reality plays out, as it has forever. Today, however, that changes.

results.title: The Woods Run Red – The Making of “Hunter’s Blood”
results.original_title: The Woods Run Red – The Making of “Hunter’s Blood”
results.overview: Feature-length documentary on the making of the 1986 horror film HUNTER'S BLOOD.

results.title: The Headliner
results.overview: The Headliner is a multi-generational musical drama that explores the evolution, exploitation, and enduring spirit of hip-hop culture. The film follows a reclusive, legendary producer from the genre's "golden era" who is forced out of retirement to collaborate with a fiercely talented but unguided modern street rapper. As they clash over the soul of their music, they must unite to fight corporate greed and protect the artistic integrity of the culture.

results.title: Lady Parts
results.overview: Based on a true story, a young woman undergoes a vulvar vestibulectomy with the help of her loving but overbearing parents, learning through recovery to embrace open conversations about sexual health and advocate for herself in every aspect of her life.

results.title: The Road to Jericho
results.overview: A journey from Jerusalem and start going to Jericho, keeping in mind that the first agreement that had been signed by Yitzhak Rabin was first dealing with Gaza and Jericho. We see a little hamlet of some Bedouin tents, called Khan El Ahmar. And it s a small community of 300 members. But recently there were threats to destroy it , which is not so much something that Rabin would like to hear.

results.title: Motherhood
results.overview: From childhood onward, rules are imposed on us, behaviours are dictated to us, and we are told “how to live,” but we are never prepared for the difficulty of “being.” This film explores this question through the lens of motherhood.

results.title: For Boredom
results.overview: The director plays with the camera, creating a short experimental film.

results.title: Elza
results.overview: With her radical voice, visceral improvisation, and unmistakable rasp, Elza Soares created a language all her own and crossed generations, continually reinventing herself as one of Brazil’s greatest artists. In the documentary that bears her name, Elza narrates her own story, weaving together a diary of memories, desires, and reflections through music, in dialogue with historic Brazilian films. Through Elza and her nearly century-long life, the film offers an X-ray of a country in turmoil.

results.title: Allegro Pastell
results.overview: In the summer of 2018, novelist Tanja Arnheim and web designer Jerome Daimler have a seemingly ideal long-distance relationship in the heat of Berlin, the idyll of an inherited bungalow in the Hessian Main Valley and many train journeys in between. But the carefully cultivated balance of trust and detachment between the two hyper-reflective millennials is shaken when Tanja realizes on the night of her thirtieth birthday that the relationship could become existential.
